body:
Hey there,

Writing is eating up your schedule, and AI can genuinely help. This week we're spotlighting five tools that handle everything from social posts to blog optimization—so you can spend less time writing and more time running your business.

**This Week's Top Picks**

**Notion AI**
Write, summarize, and brainstorm without leaving your workspace. Best for: Small teams already using Notion who want AI assistance built into their planning and documentation.
*Free + $10/mo* → [Try Notion AI Free →](https://notion.so/?ref=YOURCODE)

**Jasper**
Purpose-built AI writing assistant that learns your brand voice and generates on-brand marketing content consistently. Best for: Marketing-focused teams or agencies managing multiple client voices.
*$49/mo* → [Try Jasper Free →](https://jasper.ai/?ref=YOURCODE)

**Surfer SEO**
Write content that ranks by analyzing top-performing pages and optimizing yours in real-time. Best for: Owners who need organic traffic and want to skip the SEO guesswork.
*$89/mo* → [Try Surfer SEO Free →](https://surferseo.com/?ref=YOURCODE)

(Also worth checking: **Copy.ai** for quick marketing copy in seconds [$36/mo](https://copy.ai/?ref=YOURCODE) and **Writesonic** for blogs and ads [$19/mo](https://writesonic.com/?ref=YOURCODE)—both offer free tiers to test.)

**Quick Tip**

Don't treat AI output as final. These tools are drafting assistants, not ghostwriters. Spend 5 minutes editing for your voice and specifics—it's what separates "meh" from "actually converts." Your unique perspective is still the secret ingredient.

See you next week.
